newsitem.title: USA: Tennessee says no impact from gas compressor fire.
newsitem.headline: Tennessee says no impact from gas compressor fire.

text.p: Tennessee Gas Pipeline, a unit of El Paso Energy Corp, said Monday a fire this morning at gas compressor station #530 in Bay St. Louis, Mississippi, has been extinguished and did not curtail flows on the line.

"There was a fire at a compressor station in Bay St. Louis, Mississippi. We were notified at 4:48 CDT this morning and the station was taken off line," a company spokeswoman said, adding the station was an unmanned station.
She said the company was still evaluating the extent of any damage, adding "The fire did not curtail any gas flows."
The cause of the fire was not known, she said.
